page.overview:
Who is Seven Fairies?

The are a group of attendants of the Queen Mother of the West.

The Seven Fairies went to harvest peaches from the Peach Tree Garden and stumbled upon Sun Wukong, who was supposed to be protecting the grove, sleeping after eating some of the peaches. When Sun Wukong found out he hadn't been invited to the banquet, he used a spell that froze the Seven Fairies in place for an entire day.
